purpose: Noncommercial retrospective next-view-basket recommendation research; independent of Olist and UCI RFM

license.permitted_project_scope: local noncommercial learning and offline research, subject to license conditions
license.attribution: Retailrocket recommender system dataset, Roman Zykov / retailrocket, Kaggle version 2, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; accessed 2026-10-28; derived processing must identify changes
license.commercial_deployment: not authorized by this license; obtain suitable rights or use another source before commercial reuse
license.adapted_data_sharing: retain attribution and notices; indicate modifications; use same or compatible license where applicable; no extra downstream restrictions
license.repository_rule: raw data, row-level outputs, credentials and model files stay Git ignored; code license does not relicense source data

parsing.format: CSV with header, standard quoting, exact header and field counts
parsing.identifier_type: opaque canonical ASCII decimal strings; zero valid; no cross-dataset identity joins
parsing.timestamp: integer Unix milliseconds, UTC, no rounding or local timezone conversion for logic
parsing.raw_values: preserve original strings; no whitespace stripping, imputation, float identifier parsing or inferred prices
parsing.empty_transactionid: valid for view/addtocart; transaction requires a canonical nonempty identifier
parsing.bad_row: retain source locator and reason in exclusion ledger; never silently coerce or drop
parsing.unexpected_source_hash: stop build; new source version requires new contract

identity_and_duplicates.event_content_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON array of the five original strings, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(',',':')
identity_and_duplicates.main_policy: one canonical valid row per exact five-field content key, lowest source record number; preserve all duplicate-to-canonical mappings
identity_and_duplicates.interpretation: identical rows are indistinguishable at published resolution; deduplication is a research convention, not proof of ingestion duplication
identity_and_duplicates.distinct_transactionid: do not deduplicate merely on the first four event fields
identity_and_duplicates.other_repeated_views: keep separate timestamps; no global visitor-item deduplication
identity_and_duplicates.raw_sensitivity: preserve multiplicity in a separate ledger; primary basket sets are invariant to exact duplicate views; no alternative-arm selection on test
identity_and_duplicates.transactionid: not a row primary key or proven globally unique order key; source audit conflict counts retained; transaction analysis deferred
identity_and_duplicates.visitorid: anonymous source visitor key; no proof of persistent person, household or account

time_roles.interval_convention: start inclusive, end exclusive; both query and target must lie within the same role window
time_roles.tail: events on/after 2015-09-18 are excluded from v1 features, catalog, fitting, labels and evaluation
time_roles.warmup_use: causal history and first-seen catalog only; no warmup labels or fitted statistics
time_roles.selection: select model and settings on training/validation only; freeze before reserved-test scoring; one final refit on train+validation allowed
time_roles.source_exposure: full source structure, counts and timestamp range inspected; no recommendation labels, ranks or metrics computed this round
time_roles.test_interpretation: reserved chronological retrospective test after protocol freeze; not a prospective, ingestion-time-verified or pristine unseen source
time_roles.boundary_sessions: past context may cross role boundaries, but supervised query-target pairs may not; no random row split

primary_task.name: next distinct timestamp view basket within a reconstructed view session
primary_task.cart_and_transaction: retain in qualified event ledger and separate aggregates; not primary features, labels, weights or negative evidence
primary_task.session_group: visitorid; view timestamps in increasing integer order
primary_task.new_session_condition: gap strictly greater than 1800000 ms; equality stays in same session
primary_task.simultaneous_views: collapse into an unordered set of distinct itemid at each visitor/timestamp; never infer order from CSV or item ID
primary_task.query_context: all view baskets in current session through query timestamp inclusive; current same-millisecond basket considered jointly observed
primary_task.target: set of distinct items at the next strictly later view timestamp in the same session
primary_task.maturity: query_ms + 1800000 <= role_end_ms, and target_ms < role_end_ms; otherwise boundary/right-censored ledger
primary_task.no_later_target: unlabelled/no observed continuation; keep denominator and reason; never label as dislike or nonpurchase
primary_task.history_at_query: only event timestamps <= query timestamp; model/cooccurrence/popularity statistics frozen before fit cutoff
primary_task.repeats: previously viewed items remain candidates and targets; no seen-item removal
primary_task.abnormal_traffic: no v1 outcome-dependent bot/user deletion, global k-core, winsorization or full-period activity threshold; report training-defined activity slices
primary_task.identity_leakage: same visitor across time roles allowed for causal sequential evaluation; visitor overlap reported, no random user leakage claim

candidate_catalog.primary: all distinct itemid with a qualified view strictly before query_ms, including warmup; no future event or property-only item enumeration
candidate_catalog.interpretation: historically observed items, not a verified sellable or exposed catalog
candidate_catalog.future_only_target: retain target in overall denominator, count inaccessible item as a miss; report target reachability and conditional metrics separately
candidate_catalog.new_to_model_item: candidate stays eligible; deterministic training-popularity fallback, zero count allowed
candidate_catalog.unknown_visitor: session context where available plus same frozen popularity fallback; report support separately
candidate_catalog.negative_sampling: none in evaluation; score/rank full causal candidate catalog; unobserved items are unlabelled, not proven negatives
candidate_catalog.ranking_ties: descending score then ascending numeric itemid, unique ranked item IDs
candidate_catalog.short_list: return min(K, catalog size); never pad with future or repeated IDs
candidate_catalog.availability_diagnostic: optional separately labelled catalog restriction using latest available strictly before query; require value 1, exclude 0 and unknown, report lost targets; does not replace primary

properties_and_categories.v1_model_features: none; source integrity and temporal availability diagnostics only
properties_and_categories.join: same itemid/property; latest property timestamp strictly less than query_ms
properties_and_categories.exact_duplicates: collapse same itemid/property/timestamp/value with part+record lineage
properties_and_categories.same_timestamp_conflict: distinct values for same itemid/property/timestamp => unknown at that version; no file-order or older-value fallback; later unambiguous version can resolve
properties_and_categories.missing_prior_version: unknown; no backward fill from future snapshots
properties_and_categories.invalid_critical_value: quarantine version and mark unknown; do not infer from purchase or view
properties_and_categories.staleness: report age of last prior snapshot; weekly snapshots do not prove continuous inventory or ingestion availability
properties_and_categories.category_tree: untimed static descriptive taxonomy only; not historical feature evidence; missing parent/conflict/cycle retained as diagnostics
properties_and_categories.generic_hashed_values: preserve opaque tokens; no recovered names, currencies or product prices; use as features requires new feature contract and key-conflict audit

evaluation.primary_metric: query-macro NDCG@10 over all qualified labelled queries, binary relevance to full next basket; IDCG uses min(K, full target set size), including unreachable targets
evaluation.recall: hits in unique ranked top K divided by full target basket size
evaluation.hit_rate: one iff at least one target is in top K
evaluation.mrr: 1/rank of first target if rank<=K, otherwise zero
evaluation.coverage: unique recommended IDs divided by union of primary candidate IDs over evaluated queries; report both counts
evaluation.empty_cases: no evaluable queries => null metric and reason; empty catalog => empty ranking and zero retrieval metrics for nonempty target
evaluation.conditional_metrics: queries whose entire nonempty target set is contained in the primary candidate catalog; report separate query/visitor/target counts; never replace unconditional primary score
slices: new vs previously observed visitors at fit cutoff
target items known vs unknown to fitted model
activity slices based on training only
evaluation.support_floor: max(50, ceil(0.01 * split labelled query count)); smaller slices descriptive only, visitor support also reported
evaluation.comparisons: same query IDs, candidate catalog, fit cutoff, target sets and metric definitions for every algorithm
evaluation.uncertainty: future comparisons resample visitor clusters, not dependent individual queries; do not claim an effect from sparse slices
evaluation.business_claims: offline continuation relevance only; no revenue, conversion lift, causal or commercial serving conclusion

required: source/code/contract hashes, manifest and output guard
acceptance: every source event accounted exactly once as canonical/duplicate/excluded
no raw or processed row data in Git
all query history timestamps <= query timestamp
all catalog first-seen timestamps < query timestamp
all property joins strictly precede query
target strictly later, within session/horizon and same role
no test fit, tuning, negative mining or corpus-wide feature filtering
independent raw-to-output reconciliation and full output readback

change_control: bind contract and source audit with SHA256 before any real builder/evaluation; preserve this v1 and create v2 for changed source, split, target, candidate or policy
